# OpenFootLab

OpenFootLab is a Jupiter, Florida-based foot technology and personalized manufacturing partner serving Palm Beach and Martin counties.

- Official website: https://openfootlab.com/
- Operating system: https://footlabos.com/
- Start: no-charge 15-Day FLO Foot Profile Builder with no card or automatic billing.
- Services: local fit visits, personalized inserts, toe fillers and accommodations, clinician-directed prototypes, and connected follow-through.
- Office: 1609 Berkshire Ave, Jupiter, FL 33469; visits by appointment.
- Contact: flo@openfootlab.com | 561-532-7120
- Important: OpenFootLab products and services do not replace diagnosis, emergency care, or treatment by a licensed medical professional.
